data.name: PrivacyPolicy
data.value:
SecRandom Privacy Policy (Version 1)
1. Scope and acceptance. SecRandom is a random selection tool for educational activities. By continuing to use the software, you acknowledge and accept this privacy policy; it does not remove rights granted by applicable law.
2. Local data. Rosters, prizes, history, and settings are stored locally by default. Only import data that is lawful, accurate, authorized, and necessary.
3. Sentry telemetry. When enabled, the app may upload crash, log, trace, and performance data to diagnose issues and improve stability. This does not control online-status reporting.
4. Online-status reporting. Standard reporting counts online users and includes approximate location derived from public IP. Anonymous reporting only counts online users and sends no IP or location. Off sends no online-status report.
5. Choices and changes. These privacy options are enabled by default and can be changed here or later in Settings > General > Privacy.
6. Network requests. The app makes the corresponding telemetry or online-status requests only when the related option is enabled. Future requests stop after the option is disabled.
7. Updates and termination. Material changes to this privacy policy increase its version and require renewed acknowledgement. You may stop using the software at any time.
8. GPLv3. This policy does not replace or restrict GNU GPLv3 rights for source code, modifications, and distribution.

data.name: VerificationNotice
data.value:
About verifiable draws
1. Ordinary mode records the candidate pool, weights, rules, random material, and result. It can complete draws offline and save a locally reproducible proof; new draws are submitted to fair.sectl.cn for independent replay and signing when online. Offline or failed historical proofs are never automatically resent, but can be uploaded manually to the verification site after connectivity is restored. The signature reveals later proof-file tampering.
2. Formal notarization mode first locks the anonymous candidate pool, weights, and rules at fair.sectl.cn. The server then generates random material, calculates the result, and stores an immutable official proof. Network disruption, outage, service unavailability, device failure, or other force majeure before final server evidence is returned never substitutes a local result or automatically changes mode. Once the server confirms the lock, the pool, rules, random material, and result cannot be replaced, supplemented, or recalculated during that draw.
3. Formal notarization protects the locked flow from replacement of local draw code, random material, or result files. It cannot prove that the real-world roster is complete or authentic, nor that the pool was not manipulated before submission.
